name: r12
purpose: Full-seven residual compensation after r11 audits. Width1.70 improves V2 upper error but shifts V4 upper to+36.85deg. H2-H3 low-edge cyclic=-23.39 and H4 upper=+26.44. Extend H_L5 by0.07mm and H_L2 by0.10mm relative r11, and extend V_L7 by0.20mm; fixed Vcommon width1.70 and RLC. This is a joint exploratory compensation based on signed residuals, not established single-branch sensitivities; evaluate entire geometry and amplitude. V2 upper residual may remain. No claim of 2-bit or broadband convergence.
